586-864-3125-3967-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-3967-6351.description:
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Teval.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

2393-2511-2738-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sifter of Skulls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3534-5627-7857.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
You control seven or more lands with different names.
3534-5627-7857.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4885-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1008-4091-7791.description:
Activate Undermountain Adventurer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Undermountain Adventurer.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Undermountain Adventurer.
Repeat.

1824-3771-4549.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed, or are venturing in, Tomb of Annihilation.
1824-3771-4549.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {2}{B} reduced by Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Acererak enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Acererak, adding {B}.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.
1824-3771-4549.notes: The cost can be reduced by at most {3} if Animar starts with +1/+1 counters on it.

1069-1374-5499-7296--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1374-5499-7296--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

222-527-2921-7296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2921-7296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

930-2292-6871-6879.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Universal Automaton.
When Universal Automaton dies, Haru triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2363-5224-5645.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Stenn, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Equipment That Gives Haste to a Creature

1402-4082-4763--78.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Kemba triggers, attaching an Equipment to Diamond Lion that will give Diamond Lion haste.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2279-2946-4050.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2279-2946-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2-4659-5491-5554.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating a 1/1 Gnome artifact creature token and a Map token.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Gnome and Map, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2105-2438-6591--85.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-2438-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

325-392-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-392-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
325-392-5796-6282.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
Resolve all Harnfel abilities.

1750-2099-2793-5131-5261.description:
Activate Sarcatog's second ability by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Spike Cycle - {2}, remove a +1/+1 counter: Put a +1/+1 counter

4659-5365--11.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
4659-5365--11.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Spike.
Activate the Spike by paying {2} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat.

1479-1817-3257.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1817-3257.description:
Cast Kodama of the East Tree by paying {4}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Kodama of the East Tree spell, with the copy not being legendary.
Resolve both Kodama of the East Tree spells.
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
Both Kodama of the East Trees and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Repeat from step 7.

31-310-1068.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least eight cards in their graveyard.
31-310-1068.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
When Leveler enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library.
Activate Merfolk Windrobber by sacrificing it, causing you to return Merfolk Windrobber from your graveyard to the battlefield due to Out of the Tombs.
Repeat step 3.

1799-2048-3621-5256.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of eight or greater.
1799-2048-3621-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi Cave Guard's power.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

4163-4551-5109.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least one.
4163-4551-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to you and Metropolis Reformer.
Metropolis Reformer triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the damage dealt to it.

1636-2810-4587-5072.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
At most {2} plus three mana of any three different colors available, plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
1636-2810-4587-5072.description:
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Cast Sliver Grandmother from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Sliver Grandmother enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers.
Holding priortiy, activate Sliver Gravemother by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Activate Sliver Gravemother by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
Choose not to return Sliver Gravemother to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Sliver Gravemother ability, giving target Sliver +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Sliver Gravemother's encore ability by paying {5} and exiling it.
Choose to return Sliver Gravemother to the command zone from exile.
Resolve the Sliver Gravemother ability, creating a token copy of it for each opponent you have.
When the Sliver Gravemother tokens enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate the Sliver Gravemother tokens by tapping them, adding at least three mana of any color(s).
Resolve the first Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Repeat from step 15 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

1247-2034-4044-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pili-Pala, adding {C}{C}.
When Pili-Pala dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Pili-Pala on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Pili-Pala from the top of your library by paying {2}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-640-3247-3327.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least three.
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
392-640-3247-3327.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Razaketh by paying two life and sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Dross Harvester's second ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the Razaketh ability, causing you to search your library for a card and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

1681-4050-4140.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd.
When Twilight Shepherd dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Giada.
Repeat.

280-1479-4862.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1479-4862.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Omnath, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Omnath trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
